          Study budget & provenance
          

          

          Meet the system.
          Four roles. Evidence, experiments and reviewed prevention.
          

          Live reasoning · Gemini on Vertex AI
          Resolution agent
          Reads the customer’s complaint, selects evidence and versioned detector tools, and proposes a resolution backed by the case records.
          It can ask the customer a question, compare patterns, or train a small behavior model when that adds useful evidence.
          

          Gemini learns after review
          Prevention agent
          Turns a reviewed resolution into a candidate safeguard, then tests changed recipients and legitimate controls. An analyst decides whether to activate it.
          Active safeguards run locally in the payment gateway, before debit. No Gemini call per payment.
          

          Curated data · bounded experiments
          Risk scientist
          Chooses a testable hypothesis, feature groups and approved model recipes. Training runs in a bounded CPU process; test labels stay outside its prompt.
          Measured results · independent role
          Model-risk validator
          Inspects actual held-out results and counterexamples. It can reject the study or recommend an eligible candidate for human review. It cannot bypass the validation gates or deploy a model.
          BigQuery + bounded local training
          Evidence and model tools
          Registered device, velocity and payment-message detectors provide versioned signal scores. BigQuery supplies customer history; an optional local model measures unusual spending. Scores are not calibrated fraud probabilities.
          Warehouse tables
            

            Human decision
            Analyst review
            Checks the proposed resolution and decides what may enter the knowledge base. Bank actions, refunds, and legal fault are never decided by the simulator.
            Philippine guidance routes complaints through the provider’s assistance process and, when needed, BSP-CAM.
